primitive_inventory.growth: open-ended and resource-bounded only by the executing runtime
primitive_inventory.closure: discovered primitives can immediately compose into deeper primitives
primitive_inventory.identity: deterministic canonical hash of normalized mathematical composition and typed signature
primitive_inventory.reducibility: every discovered primitive retains a complete expansion to the seven roots

continual_learning.contradiction: revises and weakens a crystallized structure
continual_learning.root_exception: roots cannot be observed into, revised, decayed, retired, or replaced

discovery_experiment.generation: algorithmic breadth and recursive depth search
discovery_experiment.claim_boundary: simulation evidence only; not proof of complete physics, quantum mechanics, or universal mathematics

runtime_knowledge.wiki: dynamic graph generated from the serialized primitive artifact
runtime_knowledge.rag: node-first retrieval followed by composition-edge propagation

side_view.binding: exact model artifact hash, graph hash, report hash, workflow hash, and knowledge hash
